subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: Should this redesign enforce the stated leading-edge sidebar control on every root destination, including Settings, before the shared sidebar shell lands?
rationale: The PR describes a single iOS navigation convention, but its Settings implementation visibly diverges; only the product owner can intentionally approve a destination-specific exception.

options.title: Keep one leading-edge convention
options.body: Move the Settings sidebar reveal button to the leading toolbar slot and retain the stated consistent root-navigation model.

options.title: Approve a Settings exception
options.body: Keep the trailing Settings control only if maintainers explicitly want Settings to use a different root-navigation affordance.

recommendation.title: Keep one leading-edge convention
recommendation.body: Move the Settings sidebar reveal button to the leading toolbar slot and retain the stated consistent root-navigation model.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit and related-issue history identifies steipete as the person most directly connected to this navigation redesign.
